


``` {r}
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

# Ao renderizar este arquivo, o diretório de trabalho pode ser a pasta runs/.
runs_dir <- if (dir.exists("runs")) "runs" else "."

metric_files <- list.files(
  runs_dir,
  pattern = "metrics\\.jsonl$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

read_jsonl <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  lines <- lines[nzchar(lines)]
  if (length(lines) == 0) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(lapply(lines, fromJSON))
}

get_first_existing <- function(df, candidates) {
  for (nm in candidates) {
    if (nm %in% names(df)) return(nm)
  }
  return(NA_character_)
}

summarise_run <- function(path) {
  df <- read_jsonl(path)
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  run_name <- basename(dirname(path))

  staging_f1_col <- get_first_existing(df, c(
    "val_staging_f1_macro", "staging_f1_macro", "val_stg_f1"
  ))
  staging_kappa_col <- get_first_existing(df, c(
    "val_staging_kappa", "staging_kappa", "val_stg_kappa"
  ))

  rswa_f1_col <- get_first_existing(df, c(
    "val_rswa_rswa_f1_macro", "rswa_rswa_f1_macro", "val_f1_macro"
  ))
  rswa_kappa_col <- get_first_existing(df, c(
    "val_rswa_rswa_kappa_macro", "rswa_rswa_kappa_macro", "val_rswa_kappa_macro"
  ))
  rswa_tonic_f1_col <- get_first_existing(df, c("val_rswa_tonic_f1", "rswa_tonic_f1"))
  rswa_phasic_f1_col <- get_first_existing(df, c("val_rswa_phasic_f1", "rswa_phasic_f1"))
  rswa_any_f1_col <- get_first_existing(df, c("val_rswa_any_f1", "rswa_any_f1"))

  epoch_col <- if ("epoch" %in% names(df)) "epoch" else NA_character_
  fold_col <- if ("fold" %in% names(df)) "fold" else NA_character_

  out <- tibble(
    run = run_name,
    path = path
  )

  if (!is.na(staging_f1_col)) {
    idx_stg <- which.max(df[[staging_f1_col]])
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        best_staging_f1 = df[[staging_f1_col]][idx_stg],
        best_staging_kappa = if (!is.na(staging_kappa_col)) df[[staging_kappa_col]][idx_stg] else NA_real_,
        best_staging_epoch = if (!is.na(epoch_col)) df[[epoch_col]][idx_stg] else NA_real_,
        best_staging_fold = if (!is.na(fold_col)) df[[fold_col]][idx_stg] else NA_real_
      )
  } else {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        best_staging_f1 = NA_real_,
        best_staging_kappa = NA_real_,
        best_staging_epoch = NA_real_,
        best_staging_fold = NA_real_
      )
  }

  if (!is.na(rswa_f1_col)) {
    idx_rswa <- which.max(df[[rswa_f1_col]])
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        best_rswa_f1 = df[[rswa_f1_col]][idx_rswa],
        best_rswa_kappa = if (!is.na(rswa_kappa_col)) df[[rswa_kappa_col]][idx_rswa] else NA_real_,
        best_rswa_tonic_f1 = if (!is.na(rswa_tonic_f1_col)) df[[rswa_tonic_f1_col]][idx_rswa] else NA_real_,
        best_rswa_phasic_f1 = if (!is.na(rswa_phasic_f1_col)) df[[rswa_phasic_f1_col]][idx_rswa] else NA_real_,
        best_rswa_any_f1 = if (!is.na(rswa_any_f1_col)) df[[rswa_any_f1_col]][idx_rswa] else NA_real_,
        best_rswa_epoch = if (!is.na(epoch_col)) df[[epoch_col]][idx_rswa] else NA_real_,
        best_rswa_fold = if (!is.na(fold_col)) df[[fold_col]][idx_rswa] else NA_real_
      )
  } else {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(
        best_rswa_f1 = NA_real_,
        best_rswa_kappa = NA_real_,
        best_rswa_tonic_f1 = NA_real_,
        best_rswa_phasic_f1 = NA_real_,
        best_rswa_any_f1 = NA_real_,
        best_rswa_epoch = NA_real_,
        best_rswa_fold = NA_real_
      )
  }

  out
}

tabela_comparativa <- metric_files %>%
  map_dfr(summarise_run) %>%
  arrange(desc(best_rswa_f1), desc(best_staging_f1))

print(tabela_comparativa, n = Inf)

# Se quiser salvar:
write_csv(tabela_comparativa, file.path(runs_dir, "tabela_comparativa_f1_kappa.csv"))
```

## Resultados de teste

```{r carregar-resultados-teste}
get_nested_value <- function(x, keys) {
  for (key in keys) {
    if (is.null(x) || is.null(x[[key]])) return(NULL)
    x <- x[[key]]
  }
  x
}

as_numeric_or_na <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else as.numeric(x)
}

summarise_test_run <- function(path) {
  dados <- fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  teste <- get_nested_value(dados, c("summary", "test"))
  run_name <- basename(dirname(path))

  staging_f1 <- as_numeric_or_na(
    get_nested_value(teste, c("staging", "ensemble", "f1_macro"))
  )
  tonic_f1 <- as_numeric_or_na(
    get_nested_value(teste, c("movement", "tonic", "ensemble", "f1"))
  )
  phasic_f1 <- as_numeric_or_na(
    get_nested_value(teste, c("movement", "phasic", "ensemble", "f1"))
  )
  any_f1 <- as_numeric_or_na(
    get_nested_value(teste, c("movement", "any", "ensemble", "f1"))
  )
  rswa_componentes <- c(tonic_f1, phasic_f1, any_f1)

  tibble(
    run = run_name,
    test_staging_f1 = staging_f1,
    test_rswa_macro_f1 = if (all(!is.na(rswa_componentes))) mean(rswa_componentes) else NA_real_,
    test_rswa_tonic_f1 = tonic_f1,
    test_rswa_phasic_f1 = phasic_f1,
    test_rswa_any_f1 = any_f1
  )
}

summary_files <- list.files(
  runs_dir, pattern = "summary\\.json$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE
)

tabela_teste <- summary_files %>%
  map_dfr(summarise_test_run) %>%
  filter(if_any(-run, ~ !is.na(.x))) %>%
  arrange(desc(test_rswa_macro_f1), desc(test_staging_f1))

print(tabela_teste, n = Inf)
write_csv(tabela_teste, file.path(runs_dir, "tabela_resultados_teste_f1.csv"))

extract_test_folds <- function(teste, caminho, categoria, campo = "f1") {
  registros <- get_nested_value(teste, caminho)
  if (is.null(registros) || length(registros) == 0) {
    return(tibble(fold = integer(), categoria = character(), f1 = numeric()))
  }

  map_dfr(registros, function(registro) {
    tibble(
      fold = as.integer(registro$fold),
      categoria = categoria,
      f1 = as_numeric_or_na(registro[[campo]])
    )
  })
}

summarise_test_folds <- function(path) {
  dados <- fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  teste <- get_nested_value(dados, c("summary", "test"))
  run_name <- basename(dirname(path))

  por_categoria <- bind_rows(
    extract_test_folds(teste, c("staging", "per_fold"), "Staging", "f1_macro"),
    extract_test_folds(teste, c("movement", "tonic", "per_fold"), "Tonic"),
    extract_test_folds(teste, c("movement", "phasic", "per_fold"), "Phasic"),
    extract_test_folds(teste, c("movement", "any", "per_fold"), "Any")
  )

  if (all(c("Tonic", "Phasic", "Any") %in% por_categoria$categoria)) {
    rswa_macro <- por_categoria %>%
      filter(categoria %in% c("Tonic", "Phasic", "Any")) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = categoria, values_from = f1) %>%
      filter(if_all(c(Tonic, Phasic, Any), ~ !is.na(.x))) %>%
      transmute(fold, categoria = "RSWA macro", f1 = (Tonic + Phasic + Any) / 3)
  } else {
    rswa_macro <- tibble(fold = integer(), categoria = character(), f1 = numeric())
  }

  bind_rows(por_categoria, rswa_macro) %>%
    mutate(run = run_name, .before = fold)
}

dados_teste_por_fold <- summary_files %>%
  map_dfr(summarise_test_folds) %>%
  filter(!is.na(f1))

resumo_teste_por_fold <- dados_teste_por_fold %>%
  group_by(run, categoria) %>%
  summarise(
    pior = min(f1),
    media = mean(f1),
    melhor = max(f1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

margem_erro_teste <- dados_teste_por_fold %>%
  group_by(run, categoria) %>%
  summarise(
    n_folds = n(),
    media_f1 = mean(f1),
    desvio_padrao = sd(f1),
    erro_padrao = desvio_padrao / sqrt(n_folds),
    t_critico_95 = qt(0.975, df = n_folds - 1),
    margem_erro_95 = t_critico_95 * erro_padrao,
    ic95_inferior = media_f1 - margem_erro_95,
    ic95_superior = media_f1 + margem_erro_95,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Os folds sao pareados entre runs: os arquivos fold_<n>_split.json sao iguais.
comparar_runs_pareados <- function(df_categoria) {
  runs <- sort(unique(df_categoria$run))
  pares <- combn(runs, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  map_dfr(pares, function(par) {
    comparacao <- df_categoria %>%
      filter(run %in% par) %>%
      select(run, fold, f1) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = run, values_from = f1) %>%
      drop_na(all_of(par))
    diferencas <- comparacao[[par[1]]] - comparacao[[par[2]]]

    if (length(diferencas) < 2 || sd(diferencas) == 0) {
      return(tibble(
        run_a = par[1], run_b = par[2], n_folds = length(diferencas),
        diferenca_media = mean(diferencas),
        ic95_inferior = NA_real_, ic95_superior = NA_real_, p_valor = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    teste <- t.test(diferencas, mu = 0, conf.level = 0.95)
    tibble(
      run_a = par[1], run_b = par[2], n_folds = length(diferencas),
      diferenca_media = mean(diferencas),
      ic95_inferior = unname(teste$conf.int[1]),
      ic95_superior = unname(teste$conf.int[2]),
      p_valor = teste$p.value
    )
  })
}

comparacoes_pareadas <- dados_teste_por_fold %>%
  group_by(categoria) %>%
  group_modify(~ comparar_runs_pareados(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(categoria) %>%
  mutate(
    p_ajustado_bh = p.adjust(p_valor, method = "BH"),
    significativo_5pct = !is.na(p_ajustado_bh) & p_ajustado_bh < 0.05
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(margem_erro_teste, file.path(runs_dir, "margem_erro_teste_folds.csv"))
write_csv(comparacoes_pareadas, file.path(runs_dir, "comparacoes_pareadas_teste_folds.csv"))

print(margem_erro_teste, n = Inf)
print(comparacoes_pareadas, n = Inf)
```

```{r grafico-f1-teste-por-fold, fig.width=13, fig.height=13}
ggplot() +
  geom_linerange(
    data = resumo_teste_por_fold,
    aes(x = run, ymin = pior, ymax = melhor),
    colour = "grey55",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = dados_teste_por_fold,
    aes(x = run, y = f1),
    colour = "grey70",
    alpha = 0.75,
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = resumo_teste_por_fold,
    aes(x = run, y = pior, colour = "Pior"),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = resumo_teste_por_fold,
    aes(x = run, y = media, colour = "Media"),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = resumo_teste_por_fold,
    aes(x = run, y = melhor, colour = "Melhor"),
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ categoria, ncol = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Pior = "#D55E00", Media = "#0072B2", Melhor = "#009E73")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    title = "Resultados de teste por fold",
    subtitle = "Linha vertical: intervalo entre pior e melhor fold; pontos cinza: folds individuais",
    x = "Run",
    y = "F1",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```

```{r grafico-f1-por-run, fig.width=13, fig.height=6}
dados_grafico_f1 <- tabela_comparativa %>%
  select(
    run,
    best_staging_f1,
    best_rswa_f1,
    best_rswa_tonic_f1,
    best_rswa_phasic_f1,
    best_rswa_any_f1
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -run,
    names_to = "categoria",
    values_to = "f1"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    categoria = recode(
      categoria,
      best_staging_f1 = "Staging",
      best_rswa_f1 = "RSWA macro",
      best_rswa_tonic_f1 = "Tonic",
      best_rswa_phasic_f1 = "Phasic",
      best_rswa_any_f1 = "Any"
    ),
    grupo = if_else(categoria == "Staging", "Staging", "RSWA")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(f1))

ggplot(dados_grafico_f1, aes(x = run, y = f1, fill = categoria)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", f1)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = -0.35,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  facet_grid(. ~ grupo, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    Staging = "#0072B2",
    `RSWA macro` = "#D55E00",
    Tonic = "#009E73",
    Phasic = "#CC79A7",
    Any = "#E69F00"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "F1 de validacao por run",
    subtitle = "Tonic, phasic e any no ponto de melhor F1 macro RSWA",
    x = "Run",
    y = "F1",
    fill = "Metrica"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```

## Comparacao pareada entre datasets

```{r friedman-wilcoxon-datasets}
friedman_global <- read_csv(
  file.path(runs_dir, "tabela_friedman_global.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    estatistica_friedman = round(estatistica_friedman, 3),
    p_friedman = format(p_friedman, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
  )

wilcoxon_pareado <- read_csv(
  file.path(runs_dir, "tabela_wilcoxon_pareado.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    media_a_pct = round(media_a_pct, 3),
    media_b_pct = round(media_b_pct, 3),
    estatistica_w = round(estatistica_w, 3),
    p_wilcoxon = format(p_wilcoxon, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3),
    p_bh = format(p_bh, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
  )

knitr::kable(
  friedman_global,
  caption = "Teste de Friedman para os 83 sujeitos comuns entre os quatro datasets."
)

knitr::kable(
  wilcoxon_pareado,
  caption = "Comparacoes pareadas por Wilcoxon com correcao de Benjamini-Hochberg."
)
```
